title: The Puzzle Phantom of Willowbrook
instructions: The Puzzle Phantom has stolen the Golden Owl Trophy! Help Detective Riley and Sam follow the Phantom's notes across Willowbrook. Tap to read the story, then solve each puzzle to find the next clue.

levels.name: The Phantom's Note
levels.instruction: DRAG AND SWAP THE LETTERS TO FIND OUT THE WORDS

intro.text:
Detective Riley's House
Willowbrook Town
Front door of Detective Riley's house
A young kid opens the door and rushes inside
Riley was arranging his case files
The sudden sound of the door grabbed his attention

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Sam ? Why are you rushing ? What's wrong

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Detective Riley! Something terrible happened!

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Sam! Slow down. Tell me the issue.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Someone named the Puzzle Phantom broke into Willowbrook Elementary and took the Golden Owl Trophy.

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: The Golden Owl? That trophy is 40 years old! It's part of our town history.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Principal Martinez is really upset. And… the Phantom left this note for you!

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Let's go to my office room and read it.

Dear Detective Riley,
I am the Puzzle Phantom. I took the Golden Owl Trophy because this town has forgotten how to truly ALERN.
If you can solve my puzzles before DIMTHNIG, you'll find me - and the trophy. If you fail, I will leave Willowbrook forever and take the Golden Owl with me. Your first clue is at the YRARLIB.
Prove that curiosity and intelligence still exist in this town.
— The Puzzle Phantom
P.S - Do you like science, Detective? You'll need it very soon.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: What does it mean? Are these secret words?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: It's scrambled, Sam. This is our first puzzle. Let's figure it out.

hints: This is something you do every day at school

levels.name: Before Midnight
levels.instruction: DRAG AND SWAP THE LETTERS TO FIND OUT THE WORDS

hints: This word is a time of day, when the clock strikes 12 at night
The word starts with M and ends with T

levels.name: The First Clue
levels.instruction: DRAG AND SWAP THE LETTERS TO FIND OUT THE WORDS

hints: This is a place where you borrow books
The word starts with L and ends with Y

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Library! The first clue is at the Willowbrook Public Library!

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Yes, Sam but we gotta work fast and solve all his puzzles before midnight.

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: But why the library?

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: He mentioned science, maybe something is at the science section.

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Detective…who do you think the Puzzle Phantom is?

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: I'm not sure yet. But someone who loves learning can't be completely bad. Still, stealing was wrong. We have to stop him. Let's go!

levels.name: The Science of Matter
levels.instruction: SELECT THE CORRECT ANSWERS TO OPEN THE BOX

intro.text:
Willowbrook Public Library
	
Willowbrook Town

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: We're finally here, at the science section of the library

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: What's that ?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Looks like maybe that's our next puzzle.

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Let's Check it out.
They see a strange box with buttons
The box turned on when they got close and the screen turned green

Hello Detective,
I hid your next clue in this box. You'll need to understand the science of MATTER to reveal it.
Good luck. The clock is ticking.
— The Puzzle Phantom

questions.text: Ice is SOLID. When we add HEAT to ice, what does it become?
questions.hint: Think about what happens to ice cream on a hot day

questions.text: Water is LIQUID. If we keep heating water until it boils, what does it become?
questions.hint: What do you see coming out of a boiling kettle?

questions.text: Steam is GAS. If we COOL it down, what does it become?
questions.hint: Steam is water that got hot. What happens when it cools back down?

questions.text: FINAL QUESTION : Which of these can help ice melt?
questions.hint: Which one of these three is actually warm or hot?

outro.text: The box turns off
The locked portion of the box is now unlocked

Impressive, Detective. You understand science.
But do you understand GEOGRAPHY?
My next puzzle is hidden at the Town Hall's Geography Exhibit.
Coordinates and curiosity will guide you.
Time's running out detective.
- The Puzzle Phantom

levels.name: The Compass Rose
levels.instruction: LOCATE THE AREA IN THE MAP USING THE DIRECTIONS GIVEN

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: The Town Hall Geography Exhibit. That's downtown.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Detective, why is the Phantom doing this? If they love learning so much, why steal the Golden Owl?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: That's a very good question, Sam. Maybe they're trying to prove a point. But that doesn't make it right.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Golden Owl was won by the school's Science Club in 1985, maybe the phantom was a part of it ?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Maybe. Come on, let's get to Town Hall. We're running out of time.

Willowbrook Geo-Observatory
	
Willowbrook Town

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Finally we're at the Geography Observatory

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: What can we possibly find here detective

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Look Sam there's a note attached to the map on the wall

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Maybe that's our next clue detective

Welcome to my favorite room in Town Hall, Detective.
When I was young, every child could read a map. We knew our COMPASS DIRECTIONS without GPS. We understood our town, our world.
Can you do the same?
Use the compass rose. Count carefully. And find my next clue using the directions written on the board.
- The Puzzle Phantom

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: A compass rose? What's that?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: See that symbol on the map? It shows North, South, East, and West. It helps us navigate, that's called a compass rose

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Oh! Like in video games!

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Exactly. Now let's solve this puzzle

puzzle.title: MAP OF WILLOWBROOK
puzzle.directions:
START at the Geo-Obseravatory 
1. Go 2 blocks NORTH
2. Turn EAST and go 3 blocks
3. Turn SOUTH and go 1 block
4. Turn WEST and go 1 block
Where are you now?
hints: You can only move up, down, left or right – no diagonals!
Try to avoid the labeled letters, they might block your path
G is your start and B is your destination – think like you're navigating a real map!

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: The Bakery ! The next clue is at the bakery

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: YES ! Sam, let's move fast

levels.name: The Learning Cake
levels.instruction: SELECT THE CORRECT ANSWERS ON THE CARD

intro.text:
Willowbrook Bakery
	
Willowbrook Town

intro.speaker: baker
intro.text: Detective Riley and young Sam! What brings you here so late ?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: We're investigating the Golden Owl theft. We have reason to believe the Puzzle Phantom was here yesterday

intro.speaker: baker
intro.text: Ah, yes. There was someone...unusual. They ordered a very specific custom cake with exact measurements.

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: What did they look like?

intro.speaker: baker
intro.text: They wore a long coat and a hat, kept their face hidden. But I remember their voice, gentle, sad even

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Did they say anything ?

intro.speaker: baker
intro.text: They left me this recipe card and said, 'If a detective comes asking, have them solve this. If they can't, they don't deserve to find me.
The baker gives the recipe card to detective Riley

PHANTOM'S SPECIAL LEARNING CAKE
This recipe tests whether you truly understand
FRACTIONS and MATHEMATICS.
Answer all questions correctly, and I'll reveal
where I'm going next.
Remember: Precision in baking is like precision
in thinking. Every measurement matters.
- The Puzzle Phantom

intro.speaker: baker
intro.text: Well let's not waste time I'll tell you the questions and you'll answer.

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: YES ! let's do it, are you ready Sam ?

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Yes detective let's begin

questions.text: The recipe needs 3/4 cup of flour. The baker only has a 1/4 cup measuring scoop. How many times must the baker fill the scoop?
One batch makes 12 cupcakes. The Phantom ordered enough for their entire science class. If they need 36 cupcakes, how many batches must the baker make?
The Phantom ordered 2 dozen cookies. How many cookies is that?
The baker has 5 eggs. The recipe needs 8 eggs. How many more eggs does the baker need to buy?
If the baker starts baking at 2:30 PM and the cake takes 45 minutes to bake, what time will it be done?
questions.hint: 30 minutes after 2:30 is 3:00, then add 15 more minutes

outro.speaker: baker
outro.text: Great job detective there's another note that strange person gave, but it has nothing written on it

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Did he say anything about that note ?

outro.speaker: baker
outro.text: Yes, he said something strange-like, 'When the detective solves the mathematics, tell them to warm the note with heat'

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Warm the card? that's strange

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: No, not really, thermochromic ink or what we know as invisible ink becomes visible when interacted with heat

outro.speaker: baker
outro.text: Let's heat up the note in the warming tray
The baker heats up the note in the oven

outro.speaker: baker
outro.text: Look something is written on the note now

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: What is it ?

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Let's read it

Excellent work, Detective. You understand both mathematics and its real-world use. Yes, I was here yesterday. I ordered a cake for a celebration that never happened — the 40th reunion of our old Science Club. When I returned to the school, no one even remembered us. The Golden Owl sat forgotten in a dusty case, ignored by students who pass it every day. That is why I took it.
If you want to find me, look to the stars. I'll be at the Observatory, where we once dreamed of exploring the cosmos. Come, if you dare, and prove that learning still matters.
— The Puzzle Phantom

outro.speaker: baker
outro.text: By the looks of it the phantom can be an old professor. Well you lads must not be late, move fast.

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Detective, which professor can it be ?

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: I still don't have any idea let's find out Sam

levels.name: The Planet Door
levels.instruction: PLACE THE PLANETS IN THE PERFECT ORDER TO OPEN THE DOOR

intro.text:
Willowbrook Space Observatory
	
Willowbrook Town

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Finally we're at the Space Observatory

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: But detective how do we enter the main room ?

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Look Sam there's a note attached near the door

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Let's read it

Welcome to my sanctuary, Detective.
This Observatory was built in 1982. My Science Club raised the money through bake sales and car washes.
In 1986, we all gathered here to watch Halley's Comet.
Twenty bright students, all believing science could change the world.
Prove to me you understand our cosmic neighborhood.
Arrange the planets correctly, and the door will open.
Then meet me at the Clock Tower at midnight.
- The Puzzle Phantom

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: I know that this observatory was built by few students one of them even taught me in the willowbrook school, but who could this phantom be ?

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Detective, the phantom sounds like a nice person but they seem sad and angry with the state of our education

intro.speaker: detective
intro.text: Then we gotta make them believe Sam, let's solve this puzzle

intro.speaker: kid
intro.text: Yes detective let's do it

hints: The order goes from closest to the Sun to furthest away
The first planet is Mercury and the last planet is Neptune
My Very Eager Mother Just Served Us Nachos – first letter of each word is a planet!

outro.text: The detective and young Sam arranged the planets in order on the door
The door opens to dark a room

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: WOW A TELESCOPE !

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Beautiful isn't it, Sam ?

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Sure is, but detective the phantom isn't here

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Well there's another note attached on the wall, let's read it

You made it. And you solved every puzzle. I'm impressed. Truly.
If you want to talk, meet me at the Clock Tower.
The place where time runs out. I'll be waiting at the top
— The Puzzle Phantom

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Let's not waste any more time Sam

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Yes detective, to the clock tower then

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Yes, to the clock tower

Willowbrook Clock Tower
	
Willowbrook Town

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: PROFESSOR MARCUS WEEB !? YOU ARE THE PHANTOM !?

outro.speaker: phantom
outro.text: So my favourite student, Riley, you found me. But I'm not giving you back the trophy the people of this town don't deserve it

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: But professor stealing the trophy won't do any good to the cause you're aiming for

outro.speaker: phantom
outro.text: I already know that child but someone must do something

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: For what reasons professor ?

outro.speaker: phantom
outro.text: I thought maybe doing this will proove a point

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Well professor it worked, you know all of your puzzles are solved with the collaboration of Sam, I only guided him

outro.speaker: kid
outro.text: Yes professor you're puzzles are awesome and we do understand your reasoning

outro.speaker: phantom
outro.text: You...enjoyed them? Oh I feel like a blind man now, I visited school few weeks ago and saw the state of our students it made me very sad and angry, so I stole the trophy

outro.speaker: detective
outro.text: Stealing the trophy was wrong, Professor. But what you've done throughout the years for this town was never forgotten

outro.speaker: phantom
outro.text: I'm sorry. I let disappointment turn to anger. The trophy belongs to the future, not the past
Professor Weeb was sent to trial
Fortunately the judge understood his reasons and charged him with 70 weeks of public service to Willowbrook School
Professer Weeb opened a puzzles club, and Sam attended the club everyday to solve puzzles
And detective Riley ? He continued on with his life - new cases, new lessons and new puzzles
